description: This file defines internal data structures related to queue streaming in Orleans, specifically the StreamConsumerData class and the StreamConsumerDataState enum used for managing consumer state and data.

classes.name: StreamConsumerData
classes.description: A sealed class representing data related to a stream consumer, including its subscription ID, stream ID, consumer extension, current state, cursor, last token, filter data, and registration status.

methods.name: StreamConsumerData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of StreamConsumerData with provided subscription ID, stream ID, consumer extension, and filter data.

methods.name: SafeDisposeCursor
methods.description: Safely disposes of the cursor associated with the consumer data, catching and logging any exceptions thrown during disposal.
